ledger: Foreground man's arm and head | stationary at chin (00:00-00:01) | stationary near chin (00:05-00:09) | raises brush to hair (00:01-00:03) then reverses along the exact same trajectory back to the starting pose (00:03-00:05)

Mirror reflection | hand near upper lip, mouth closed (00:00) | hand near cheek, mouth open (00:09) | reflects upward sweep (00:01-00:05) but moves mouth and hand independently of the foreground man from 00:05-00:09

findings.description: After raising the brush to his hair from 00:01 to 00:03, the motion reverses along the identical path from 00:03 to 00:05, returning to the exact initial pose like a boomerang loop.
The reflection opens its mouth and shifts the brush across the cheek while the foreground man's jaw and hand remain lacks corresponding movement.
